description_en: Queries the AccessKey pairs that are bound to simple application servers in a specific region
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-key-pairs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-key-pair-name KeyPairName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListKeyPairs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the AccessKey pair. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Page starts from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对列表的页码。起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

KeyPairs.description_en: Details about the queried AccessKey pairs

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the AccessKey pair was created

InstanceIds.description_en: The IDs of simple application servers. A maximum of 50 IDs of simple application servers can be returned
InstanceIds.description_zh: 轻量应用服务器实例ID。最多支持50个实例ID

items.description_en: The ID of the simple application server. A maximum of 50 IDs of simple application servers can be returned
items.description_zh: 轻量应用服务器实例ID。最多支持50个实例ID

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the AccessKey pair. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
KeyPairName.description_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）

PublicKey.description_en: The content of the public key

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
